rec.name: Collection Product Card Image Slider
rec.status: Built — A/B tested on the Bestseller collection (Ablyft); re-merged into the live theme after a theme update; result not documented

what.text: A swipeable image slider on each product card in the collection grid (the ticket calls it the 'CP slider'). Shoppers can browse several product images directly in the listing without opening the PDP. The mobile screenshots show a pagination dot indicator (5 dots, first active) and previous/next arrows on the card image. The ticket is typed 'Section', but it works as an enhancement to the existing product card, so it is classed here as a Feature.

why.text: Showing more angles, detail shots and on-model views in the grid lowers the effort needed to evaluate a product. Shoppers get more visual information before clicking, so the clicks that do happen are better qualified. Dots signal that more content is available and invite interaction. Swiping is a familiar mobile pattern, as on fashion and streetwear shops (the Pegador reference). The ticket gives no rationale, so this is inferred.

how.text: Replace the single static image in the collection product card with a multi-image carousel fed by the product's media. Per the feedback: (1) place the slider navigation (dots) inside the image at the bottom left, like Pegador; (2) remove the arrows on the product image; (3) keep the image size and aspect ratio identical to the original card, because the first variant showed images smaller and squashed; (4) make sure the existing 'Model view' toggle (the 'Tragebilder' switch above the grid) still works with the slider. Run it as an A/B test, with the slider as variant B and the original card as control, and add the Ablyft customer-event pixel for tracking. Re-merge the code into the live theme whenever the store publishes a new theme.

items: Number of images per card (the screenshots show 5 dots)
Indicator style and position (dots inside the image, bottom left)
Which collections the slider applies to (test ran on /collections/bestseller)

dependencies.text: The product needs multiple media images. A custom carousel script in the theme (JS/Liquid) is needed. The Ablyft A/B testing tool plus its customer-event pixel are needed for tracking (access to Shopify Customer Events was required). The slider must be compatible with the theme's model-view toggle. After a theme replacement or publish, the code must be re-merged into the live theme. No metafields are mentioned in the ticket.

items: Add-to-cart rate from the collection page
Conversion rate and revenue per visitor

images.caption: Variant B on mobile: product cards with a dot indicator (first dot active) and prev/next arrows on the image, in a 2-column grid with BESTSELLER badges.
Original (control): the same grid with a single static image per card, no slider and no dots.
Close-up of the bundle card with the slider, 5 dots and arrows. The badges (BESTSELLER BUNDLE, SPARE 20€) overlap the image and were circled in feedback, so badge placement should be checked.
